author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಎಲ್ಲರಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗು ಎಲ್ಲರೊಡೆ ಒಡನಾಡು
ಬಲ್ಲ ಜನ ಸಂಗದಲಿ ಅನುಭವವ ಪಡೆಯೊ
ಮೆಲ್ಲುತಿರು ಸಿಹಿಕಹಿಯ ಸಮನಾಗಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿ
ಗೆಲ್ಲುವೆಯೊ ಜೀವನವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Be one with everyone, mix with all;
gain experience in the company of those who know;
keep chewing the sweet and the bitter, taking both alike,
and you will win at life, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Live among people, learn from the wise, and accept life’s sweet and bitter moments with the same steadiness. That is how a life is won.
